verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official server-side SDK, the TypeScript-first `@airwallex/node-sdk`, with strongly typed models, built-in error handling, automatic retries and token refresh. The SDK page is labeled beta, and only a Node.js SDK is evidenced. missing for 10: generally available (non-beta) SDK status, evidence of SDKs for other languages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: `@airwallex/node-sdk` is a TypeScript-first SDK designed for integrating with the Airwallex platform APIs using Node.js.
It includes features such as strongly typed request and response models, built-in error handling, automatic retries, token refresh, and support for custom requests
